transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I just feel worn out all the time. Even after I get a full night in bed, it feels like my body is made of sandbags. Just getting through a normal workday, or even doing something simple like folding laundry... it takes absolutely everything I have right now.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even activities you once found pleasurable?

Yeah, I have. I used to make time for a lot of different things—hiking, yoga, working out in my garden. I also really liked taking bird photos. But lately... I just keep canceling plans. My camera has just been sitting in the closet for a while now. It just really doesn't feel worth the effort to do any of it.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the time lately, nearly every day?

Yeah, I have. Pretty much every day. Most days I just wake up with this heavy, flat feeling in my chest. I can just sit at the kitchen table for a while, staring out at the yard, and... I don't know, I just feel like there is no good version of the future coming. It's just a constant down feeling.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before, where you felt down, exhausted, and lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days before, or times where work was stressful, but... nothing like this. This heavy, constant feeling where I just can't get myself to care about anything? This is new.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I'd say... this depressed, slowed-down feeling, the exhaustion, it's been going on most days for about the past two months now.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, have you felt unusually restless or fidgety lately?

Yeah, definitely the slower part. My husband actually pointed it out to me recently. He says I've been moving around the house like I'm underwater. And... I guess with speaking, too. If he asks me something simple, it can take me a while to actually answer him. It's like the words just come out really slowly. I haven't felt restless or fidgety at all, just very slow.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth anything, or guilty about things more than usual, even when others say you’ve done nothing wrong?

Yeah, I have. Especially the guilt part. I... I just keep replaying this mortgage decision we made recently, and I keep telling myself that I was completely selfish and reckless. It feels like I put our whole household at risk. My husband keeps reminding me that we made the decision together, but... I just can't stop feeling like it's all my fault and that I'm just awful for doing that to us.
